At one point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Devlor Samt]] and his team surveyed a supposedly uninhabited '''world'''. There, the team came under a ferocious attack by [[Voegliss's parents|two members]] of a [[Voegliss's species|sentient species]] that was not [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
